purpose: An with the project's two real image conventions: a Webflow srcset pair, and a theme-paired twin swapped at runtime.

props.assetRef: a local absolute path under /assets/ - never a remote URL
props.themePairRef: optional - the twin shown in the other palette
props.alt: required; the source ships descriptive alt on every content image and alt="" on the four decorative preloader images
props.loading: lazy on every image in the project

conventions.srcset: only the four preloader images carry one: a -p-500.avif 500w variant plus the 796w original, with sizes="(max-width: 796px) 100vw, 796px".
conventions.themePair: a pair of siblings carrying .theme-dark and .theme-light. The .theme-dark member ships style={{display:"flex"}} and .theme-light ships display:"none", and public/motion/m11.js swaps them. INVERTED: the visible-by-default member is the one classed .theme-dark and named -dark.avif, even though the page renders LIGHT. Four real pairs: two in .ai__grid and two on the 404.
conventions.crossFadeTwin: the five .ai__grid-small images each have an -upd twin carrying .is-img-anima-1..5, which public/motion/m28.js cross-fades on a 0.8-1.5s repeating loop. Four ship filter:blur(0px) inline and the fifth (is-img-anima-5) ships filter:blur(6px).

responsive.max-767px: the .ai__grid is replaced by the six-tile .ai__grid-alt mobile collage - a different element set, not a reflow of the same one

measuredFrom.quote: alt="Woman with dark hair wearing a soft blue scarf

allowedAssetRolesNote: Machine-checkable list of the assetRole ids this contract may carry, replacing the prose it previously held ('one of hero-carousel-photo, preloader-photo, product-shot-photo, step-artwork, not-found-artwork'). extraction/verify_all.py check [j] resolves every string under an assetRole key against the closed registry, so a prose sentence there would be - and was - reported as an unlisted role.
